short.text: Kevin Rutland was a reserve corner for Jacksonville in 2013, playing in {{2013.regular.games:words}} regular-season games and both playoff games and serving late in the season as the first outside reserve while A.J. Bouye was hurt. The staff saw functional movement but unfinished technique and route recognition, suited to a narrow depth role rather than a corner to isolate consistently in matchups. Press coverage, reading routes and ball skills were the least developed parts of his game.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie
Not tendered by Jacksonville; became an unrestricted free agent
No June 1 tender from Jacksonville; Jacksonville retained no rights
